summary: This is an amended Form 8-K correcting the filing date of a reverse stock split. On April 16, 2026, Nauticus Robotics, Inc. filed a certificate of amendment to effect a 1-for-8 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective April 21, 2026, to meet Nasdaq bid price requirements. The board approved the split after stockholder authorization at a January 28, 2026 special meeting. No fractional shares will be issued; rounding up applies. No consideration, premium, or deal terms are involved. This is a routine corporate action with no special-situation transaction. What to watch: trading on a split-adjusted basis begins April 21, 2026.
